name: hbm_loader_half_4d30522ee

spec.name: hbm_loader_half_4d30522ee
spec.purpose: hfd_loader half rate: unchanged ot_hfd_loader_host_m on a latch+AND gated clock (every other ck edge), handshakes gated to the gated edge; core-to-core multicycle 2/1 (loader/sdc/hfd_loader_half.sdc); 30c5fa080 SS -863 across >= 9 engine classes

bench.name: exact_ldm_half
bench.cmd: bash physical/hbm_accel_die_views/loader/rtl/run_ldm_half.sh {RUN}/bench 2>&1 | grep -v Aborted | tee {RUN}/bench.txt; grep -q 'LDM_HALF PASS' {RUN}/bench.txt

bench.name: neg_nogate_and_foh
bench.cmd: grep -q 'neg_nogate detected' {RUN}/bench.txt && grep -q 'neg_foh detected' {RUN}/bench.txt && echo LDM_NEG_FAIL && exit 1; exit 0

budget.reason: same IO recipe as the benched loader routes (io_vclk_m at the calibrated CK_SS_MEAN + vclk_corner_true + io_min); the half-rate core adds a multicycle SDC, not an IO change

spec.cycles_note: off the per-token path (boot / weight load); loader engines at ck/2 = 19.2 GB/s per die, 2x the 9.6 GB/s host link
